text:
Type: round two-tier side table
Use: holding a lamp, books and drinks; living room, bedroom, reading corner
Style: contemporary, modern, mid-century modern
Materials: beige lacquered round top and shelf, dark brown stained solid wood frame
Colors: warm beige, dark brown
Shape: thick round top and matching lower shelf, four square posts on a crossed X-shaped base, compact, medium visual weight
Feel: soft, warm, grounded, cozy
Goes with: brown leather, cream or taupe textiles, dark wood; contemporary living rooms and warm neutral bedrooms

product.name: RISSNA
product.description: Separate shelf for magazines, etc. helps you keep your things organised and the table top clear.
